title: Colby vs ConnCollege: tuition, size, location
summary: Colby College (Colby) versus Connecticut College (ConnCollege). Also searched as ConnCollege vs Colby. Scorecard table is sourced; prose is checked against those facts. UniRepository is not affiliated with either school.

sections.heading: How they differ
paragraphs: Connecticut College and Colby College are both private nonprofit institutions, as indicated by their ownership code 2 in the College Scorecard. Connecticut College, located in New London, has an undergraduate enrollment of 1,937 students, while Colby College in Waterville enrolls 2,407 undergraduates. Tuition for in-state students at Connecticut College is $67,242, slightly lower than Colby College's $69,600. These differences highlight variations in size, location, and cost between the two colleges.
